reason: My bookkeeper and I already use an expense app and it works well enough, so I don't want another bill and another sheet to check. Half of what I spend is cash to mechanics with no proper receipt anyway, so a receipt bot only covers part of my costs.
objection: I don't believe it really catches a duplicate when the same parts receipt gets photographed twice from different angles, or a mechanic sends the same handwritten nota again a week later. If it's just a receipt-to-table bot, my current app already does that.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it catch real duplicates and wrong totals on my own scooter-parts receipts during the free 30, and sync into the app my bookkeeper already uses so I'm not running two systems.
